checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same mountains, trees, clouds, lake in original positions
Reflections and surface details keep structure
must.why: Reflections are in the same places, though more saturated and contrasty.

must.item: No sun, extra clouds or elements added
must.why: No new elements, but clouds are recoloured heavily orange.

must.item: Framing, geometry and detail unchanged apart from colour
must.why: Contrast, saturation and sharpness were boosted; the result looks oversharpened and HDR-like, with a heavy orange cast.

faults.what: Very heavy, oversaturated orange grading, far beyond 'warmer'. It changes the mood from soft dusk to a fiery sunset.
Contrast and sharpening are boosted, giving an HDR-like AI look and crushed shadows, which goes beyond a colour-only change.

summary: The structure is preserved and the image is clearly warmer, but the grade is extreme, oversaturated and contrasty, so it overshoots the "just warmer colours" request.
